prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Home wait_info (6 wins), adoption redesigns (3 wins), finish redesigns (1 win), adoption new_flows (1 win), sign_in notifications (1 win), and finish new_screens (1 win) produced all winning tests.
Finish hints, sign_in redesigns, choose_path layouts, and choose_path redesigns showed no positive effect and frequently caused negative performance.
Adoption hints, choose_path copy, finish layouts, finish new_flows, home redesigns, sign_in copy, and sign_in incentives showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Kinds of change tested only once (e.g., adoption layout, adoption new_screen, adoption wait_info, choose_path reorder, sign_in reorder) remain thin evidence.
Predictions were systematically too low for major winning redesigns, reorders, and new flows.
Predictions were systematically too high for changes that resulted in no clear effect or negative performance.

0: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Interaction Live Guide: Display an interactive tip carousel on the waiting screen explaining desktop interactions during pet generation. (why: Home wait_info features produced 6 winning tests, helping set expectations for desktop pet visibility and controls.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Sound & Reaction Customization Flow: Add a sound test element during photo upload so users can preview pet voice reactions. (why: Adoption new_flows produced positive test results, and interactive preview reduces generation drop-offs.)
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Pet Habitat Status Info: Show explicit status info and readiness notifications while waiting for desktop habitat rendering. (why: Home wait_info is the strongest performing category (6 wins), easing long wait times (median 201s).)
3: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Multi-Account Desktop Restore Alert: Display an explicit account sync hint on sign-in warning users to log into their original account to preserve pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign-in notifications have proven effective.)
4: [finish, new_flow] Home Intro Desktop Pet Audio Command Flow: Add an interactive action button on the home intro screen to test voice commands with the pet. (why: Users report post-onboarding confusion regarding talking to pets, and adding interaction in finish improves onboarding completion.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Boundary Sound Activity Info: Show progress counters and estimated time remaining with sound hints on the waiting screen. (why: Home wait_info updates consistently perform well and alleviate anxiety during long background renders.)
